snippet.title: Gold Gold Adventure Gold - Early Access Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
GO FOR GOLD & PLAY NOW! ✅ 
https://t.co/FbGbmdCf3C

Hire Adventurers to Take on Quests and Hope for the Best as our fantasy rogue-like city builder, Gold Gold Adventure Gold, is available now in Steam Early Access!

Gold makes God. Embrace city-building chaos. Pet giant monsters! Watch puny adventurers! Bend nature to your will with powerful spells and the greatest of all forces nature - GOLD. 

Join the Gold Gold Adventure Gold Community Discord:
https://discord.gg/497pxkphxB

Follow CanCanCanAMan on our socials!
